caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass pitcher with a subtle blue-green tint. The pitcher has a flared lip at the top with a spout for pouring and a sturdy, wide circular base. The handle is attached to the upper part of the body and curves outward before attaching to the base, with a gentle loop at the bottom where it meets the body. The surface of the pitcher is decorated with a subtle swirling or twisted pattern that runs diagonally from the base to the top. The drawing is rendered with careful shading and highlights to emphasize the transparency and reflective nature of the glass material. The background is plain, with the pitcher centered, and the artist's signature “C. Capelli” appears in the lower-left corner within a rectangular border that frames the image.
title: Molasses Jug
